bot.q: Is this a chatbot or LINE Official Account?
bot.a: No. Agenda uses your personal LINE account for both sending and replying. No Official Account signup needed.

autoReply.a: Set keywords and reply messages — when someone types a matching word in your group, the system replies instantly 24/7. Supports images and quote replies.

risk.a: Any automated sending carries some risk. Agenda uses allowed send hours, per-job daily caps, delays between groups, and auto-stop on repeated failures. You remain responsible for your LINE account.

payment.a: Paid plans are billed monthly. See the billing page in your dashboard for payment details after signing up.

account.a: Sign up with email and password, then connect LINE from the dashboard with a QR code when you are ready.

trial.a: Connecting LINE unlocks a full 14-day Growth trial. After it ends, you must pay to keep sending and auto-reply — there is no usable free tier.

plans.a: Basic covers essentials. Growth unlocks image replies, scheduled sends, and more auto-replies. Pro adds exact matching, reply order controls, and the highest quotas.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.body: By using Agenda you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

service.title: Service description
service.body: The service helps you schedule promotional messages to LINE OpenChats and groups you belong to. You are responsible for complying with LINE's terms and applicable laws.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You must provide accurate information and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for activity under your account.

billing.title: Billing
billing.body: Paid plans are billed monthly via PromptPay. Trials and plan limits are described on the pricing page. Refunds are handled case by case.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: The service is provided as-is. We are not liable for LINE account restrictions, message delivery failures, or indirect damages.

collect.title: Information we collect
collect.body: We collect account details (name, email), LINE connection metadata, send job content, and usage logs needed to operate the service.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: We use your data to authenticate you, schedule sends, enforce plan limits, process payments, and improve reliability.

storage.title: Storage and security
storage.body: Data is stored in PostgreSQL. LINE session secrets stay on the worker volume and are not stored in the database.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.body: We do not sell your data. We share data only with infrastructure providers required to run the service or when required by law.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your account data by contacting support. Disconnect LINE anytime from the dashboard.

schedule.title: Schedule promotional messages to LINE OpenChats and groups
schedule.metaDescription: Step-by-step: connect LINE, create a message template, pick groups to send to, and create a send job in Agenda.
body: Agenda helps you schedule promotional messages to LINE OpenChats and groups you already belong to — from one dashboard.

Create a message template, choose groups to send to, set allowed send hours, and enable a send job. Agenda sends one group at a time with delays and daily limits, and can stop after repeated failures.
This is for communities you manage as a member. It is not a LINE Official Account or chatbot product.
When you are ready, create an account and connect LINE from the dashboard.

account.title: Personal LINE account versus Official Account
account.metaTitle: Personal LINE vs Official Account · Agenda
account.metaDescription: Agenda uses your personal LINE membership in OpenChats and groups — not an Official Account.
body: LINE Official Accounts are a separate product for brands that publish to followers through OA tools.
Agenda connects the personal LINE account you already use to participate in OpenChats and groups, then sends messages on the schedule you set.
Agenda is not affiliated with LINE Corporation. Automated sending always carries some account risk; use daily limits and pauses responsibly.

payment.title: PromptPay billing and slip verification
payment.metaDescription: How Agenda paid plans work with PromptPay QR codes and automatic slip verification.
body: Paid Agenda plans are billed monthly via PromptPay.
Scan the QR code shown in billing, transfer the amount, upload your payment slip, and the system verifies it automatically.
Trials and plan limits (send jobs and groups per job) are described on the pricing page. Contact support if a slip needs manual review.
